Every game, one page

Each game in this list opens on its own page with a playable build, a controls table, a short strategy guide and an FAQ. The pages are deliberately small: a game page loads one shared stylesheet, one shell script and one game module, with no framework and no external font.

If you are not sure where to start, the arcade games are the fastest to pick up, the puzzle games are the best for a quiet break, and Neon Slope is the one to open when you want a genuine reflex challenge.
